decision.reason: The only evidence is a one-line changelog entry [ev-acf625250e78]. It shows that force promote actions were added for "Numaplane rollouts", so the change (added) and the consequence (additive, nothing happens if the operator does nothing) are clear. It does not name the resource group or kinds the actions attach to, or the action names, so neither the subject nor the applicability condition can be written in typed form. The entry only points to PR #22141. That PR, or the action definitions in the release artifacts, would be needed to fill the subject and applicability.
